name: regdatalab
description: Research FDA manufacturing, inspection, warning-letter, recall and product records for any company or facility, with cited FDA record identifiers.

interface.longDescription: Ask about a company's or facility's FDA record and get a cited answer: registered manufacturing sites, inspection outcomes (NAI/VAI/OAI), Form 483 citations, warning letters, import alerts and refusals, debarments, recalls and enforcement, plus 510(k), PMA, Drugs@FDA, NDC, UDI and drug-label lookups. RegDataLab cleans and links FDA public data so one company name resolves to its subsidiaries and facilities. Read-only research tools; each call uses credits from your RegDataLab account (free tier available). Not legal or regulatory advice.
defaultPrompt: Use RegDataLab to summarize Baxter's FDA manufacturing and compliance record, with citations.
Use RegDataLab to check whether a facility (by FEI number) has had OAI inspections or warning letters.
Use RegDataLab to list Class I recalls for infusion pumps in the last two years.
